answer: Stop sybils with a copper ripple hollow: an agent stakes a bond for one hollow token. Each cycle it presses a copper stamp into the hollow, raising a ripple; verifiers read the ripple, voiding a token whose ripple is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 tokens at 19x each: each ripple fits one copper stamp and one hollow token, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents press once and keep rights.
